correctness.rationale: Exact conditional probabilities are derived separately for k=i, i<k<j, k=j, and the independent cases. The crucial intermediate-case count follows from independence of the first-k unordered values and conditional exchangeability of their nonrecord sites. Telescoping gives the right-endpoint-flat -1/[2i(i+1)] identity; linearity yields the arbitrary-weight formula. A standalone exhaustive exact-rational verifier passed 644 assertions over permutation orders 2–8. All-order conclusions depend on the proof, not enumeration.

value.rationale: The object is the complete natural dependence matrix between online record maxima and all pairwise inversions. The local kernel has three distinct geometric regimes, including bridging records, but its sum is independent of inversion span. This structural cancellation gives an exact rowwise-flat law and a sign result for every nontrivial nonnegative weighted inversion count, providing information inaccessible from known aggregate joint distributions or adjacent-only descents. It is a meaningful finite-sample characterization, not an arbitrary numerical slice or a routine parameter substitution.
